options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:

options.name: Goal Condition
options.doc:
Choose which rank must be reached in order to goal.

Novice: Complete the game, which requires 55 rank ups.
Fifty: Reach CHEATER 1, which requires 50 rank ups.
Anomaly: Reach Act 2, which requires 35 rank ups.
Master: Reach Master 1, which requires 25 rank ups.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez quel grade doit être atteint pour viser.

Novice: Compléter le jeu, ce qui nécessite 55 classements.
Fifty: Atteindre CHEATER 1, qui nécessite 50 grades.
Anomaly: Reach Act 2, qui exige 35 hausses de grade.
Master: Atteindre le Maître 1, qui nécessite 25 grades.

options.name: Champ
options.doc: Choose the champion you want to play as, or randomize this option.
options.doc_fr: Choisissez le champion que vous voulez jouer comme, ou randomiser cette option.

options.name: Remove Content After Goal?
options.doc:
Removes items and locations that only become relevant after the goal.
This setting will make the randomizer easier. If you want, you can 
balance it by slightly reducing the number of items inside the item pool below.

If you are playing with auto release, this setting should be turned on.

options.name: Number of Hypernode items
options.doc:
Hypernodes are unique powerful nodes purchasable in the item shop.
In vanilla, they are unlocked by reaching Novice with a champ.
options.doc_fr:
Les hypernœuds sont des nœuds puissants uniques et purchasables dans le magasin d'articles.
En vanille, ils sont déverrouillés en atteignant Novice avec un champion.

options.name: Total Number of Skills
options.doc:
Set the maximum amount of skills you want to find in total.
This amount includes the amount of signature and upgradable skills.
Defaults to 35, which is the vanilla amount.

To avoid fill errors, the generator may decide to lower this number automatically.

options.name: Maximum Number of Fixed Skills
options.doc:
Set the number of fixed, upgradable skills.
Defaults to 12, which is the vanilla amount.

options.name: Maximum Number of Skill Upgrades
options.doc:
Set the number of skill upgrades in the item pool.
These are used to upgrade fixed skills.
Defaults to 35, which is the vanilla amount.

You can calculate the recommended amount like this:
3 * (number of fixed skills)

To avoid fill errors, the generator may decide to lower this number automatically.

The generator will cap this number at 6 * (number of fixed skills).

options.name: Minimum amount of Crystals to include
options.doc:
Crystals are usually a major part of the game's progression,
but they also take up a high number of possible locations.

Here you can set a minimum amount of Crystals to be included
in the item pool. Crystals can still appear as filler item,
regardless of this setting.
options.doc_fr:
Les cristaux sont généralement une partie majeure de la progression du jeu, mais ils prennent aussi un grand nombre d'emplacements possibles.

Ici, vous pouvez définir un minimum de cristaux à inclure dans le pool d'articles. Les cristaux peuvent encore apparaître comme élément de remplissage, quel que soit ce paramètre.

options.name: Minimum amount of Corruption Shards to include
options.doc:
Corruption Shards are part of the game's act 2 progression,
but they also take up a high number of possible locations.

Here you can set a minimum amount of Corruption Shards to be included
in the item pool. Corruption Shards can still appear as filler item,
regardless of this setting.

The vanilla amount of corruption shard drops is 19, but since
corruption shards can also drop as filler items the default
amount was decreased to 10.
options.doc_fr:
Corruption Shards font partie de la progression de l'acte 2 du jeu, mais ils prennent également un grand nombre d'emplacements possibles.

Ici, vous pouvez définir un montant minimum de Corruption Shards à inclure dans le pool d'articles. Corruption Shards peut toujours apparaître comme élément de remplissage, quel que soit ce paramètre.

La quantité de vanille de corruption shard gouttes est 19, mais comme corruption shards peut également baisser comme les articles de remplissage le montant par défaut a été réduit à 10.

options.name: Upgrade Point Efficiency
options.doc:
This setting will reduce the number of item drops by increasing
the contents of each drop. For example, instead of receiving one 
upgrade point twice, you receive two upgrade points once.

To avoid fill errors, it is recommended to set this to at least 2.

options.name: Crystal Item Efficiency
options.doc:
This setting will reduce the number of item drops by increasing
the contents of each drop. For example, instead of receiving one 
crystal twice, you receive two crystals once.

To avoid fill errors, it is recommended to set this to at least 2.

options.name: Corruption Shard Item Efficiency
options.doc:
This setting will reduce the number of item drops by increasing
the contents of each drop. For example, instead of receiving one 
corruption shard twice, you receive two corruption shards once.

Increase this option, if you are experiencing fill errors.

options.name: Additional QBlock Breaker
options.doc:
If your goal is to reach Novice rank, you need all nine QBlock Breaker.
It is the only strict requirement in the entire game, which means you
are often waiting to receive your final QBlock Breaker to goal.

If you want to reduce the chance of getting stuck behind QBlock Breaker,
you can add extra ones here. Might be useful when playing in lobbies with
a lot of slots.

options.name: Number of Skill Distribution Gates
options.doc:
Decide when the randomizer will enforce skill type distribution settings.
By default, the randomizer will make sure your in-logic inventory will match
the distribution settings once every 10 levels. Lower values result in more
linear progression while higher values cause a more unpredictable distribution.

"Never" means skill type distribution will be entirely random and the settings below will be ignored.
options.doc_fr:
Décidez quand le randomisateur appliquera les paramètres de distribution de type de compétence.
Par défaut, le randomisateur s'assurera que votre inventaire in-logical correspondra aux paramètres de distribution une fois tous les 10 niveaux. Les valeurs inférieures entraînent une progression plus linéaire alors que les valeurs plus élevées entraînent une distribution plus imprévisible.

« Jamais » signifie que la distribution du type de compétence sera entièrement aléatoire et que les paramètres ci-dessous seront ignorés.

options.name: Maximum Percentage of Signature Skills
options.doc:
Most champion have special skills that can only be used in combination with their gimmick.
For example: Luke's Action Junky requires his Tiltmeter gimmick to work.
This setting forces some of your skills to be signature skills, making sure your gimmick is not useless.

options.name: Skill Weight: Flat Q
options.doc:
Set how many skills should be of type "Flat Q".
Higher values = more skills of that type, lower values = fewer skills of that type.
Based on the game's default skill distribution, the recommended value is 8.

options.name: Skill Weight: Q Mult
options.doc:
Set how many skills should be of type "Q Mult".
Higher values = more skills of that type, lower values = fewer skills of that type.
Based on the game's default skill distribution, the recommended value is 7 or 8.

options.name: Skill Weight: Trigger
options.doc:
Set how many skills should be of type "Trigger".
Higher values = more skills of that type, lower values = fewer skills of that type.
Based on the game's default skill distribution, the recommended value is 10.

options.name: Skill Weight: Gold
options.doc:
Set how many skills should be of type "Gold".
Higher values = more skills of that type, lower values = fewer skills of that type.
Based on the game's default skill distribution, the recommended value is 2.

options.name: Skill Weight: XP
options.doc:
Set how many skills should be of type "XP".
Higher values = more skills of that type, lower values = fewer skills of that type.
Based on the game's default skill distribution, the recommended value is 2.

options.name: Skill Weight: Other
options.doc:
Set how many skills should be of other types not listed above.
Higher values = more skills of that type, lower values = fewer skills of that type.
Based on the game's default skill distribution, the recommended value is 6.

options.name: Challenges: Amount of Locations
options.doc:
This setting adds special challenges that reward location checks.
By default, this will add 4x tier 1 challenges, 3x tier 2 challenges,
2x tier 3 challenges and 1x tier 4 challenge.

options.name: Challenges: Maximum Amount of Tier 4 Challenges
options.doc:
Here you can choose the maximum amount of tier 4 challenges to add.
Tier 4 challenges only appear if amount of challenge locations is set
to at least 10.
options.doc_fr:
Ici, vous pouvez choisir la quantité maximale de défis de niveau 4 à ajouter.
Les défis de niveau 4 n'apparaissent que si le nombre d'emplacements est fixé à au moins 10.

options.name: Recycling Set: Mode
options.doc:
Receive a check for each submitted recycling target set. 
Adds 10 locations. Requires 2x PROGRESSIVE_ITEM_RECYCLING_SYSTEM.

options.name: Trigger Combo: Maximum Amount of Triggers
options.doc:
If you want to disable this sanity, set this to 0.

Adds checks for the amount of nodes triggered in one flip.
This option changes the maximum amount of triggers required to
get all trigger checks.

By default, the last location for this sanity is placed at
100 triggers in one flip. You can change the increment below.

options.name: Trigger Combo: Increments
options.doc:
Choose the increment for the combo locations. The default
increment is 10, so the first check is at 10 triggers, then
20, and so on.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez l'accroissement pour les emplacements combo. L'accroissement par défaut est de 10, donc la première vérification est à 10 déclencheurs, alors
20, et ainsi de suite.

options.name: YAML Fixes: Automatically Increase Efficiency
options.doc:
This option takes effect when your YAML introduces more progression items
than locations.

When enabled, it will reduce the number of item drops by increasing
the contents of each drop. For example, instead of receiving one upgrade
point twice, you receive two upgrade points once.

When disabled and your YAML has too many progression items, generating a 
multiworld is going to fail.
